heading: **7 November 2025**
body:
***1\. Prepare induction media for proteins and carry out induction***

100 mL per flask 

Program 4 was run 

| ZYP-5052 ("Medium2") |  |  |  |  |
| ----- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Reagents | STOCK | Final 1x: | \~900 mL | \~1L |
| LB Broth |   | \- | 900 mL | 1000 mL |
| Carbenicillin | 1000x | 1x | already added | 1.08 mL |
| Chloramphenicol | 1000x | 1x | \-already added | 1.08 mL |
| MgSO4 | 1 M | 1 mM | 902 uL | 1.08 mL |
| Metals Mix | 1000x | 1x | 902 uL | 1.08 mL |
| 50x 5052 | 50x | 1x | 18.4 mL | 21.6 mL |
| 20x NPS | 20x | 1x | 47.4 mL | 54 mL |

***2\. ligN40w107 PCR2 QC***

Concentration of ligN40w107 PCR2 \= 3.8 ng/uL

25 uL of this sample was also run on a 2% agarose gel. The band observed was very clean and therefore the quality of the ligand at this stage is quite good. However the concentration is fairly low.

What I need \= 20 ng/uL X 20 X 400 \= 160 ug 

From one PCR run ⇒ 19 ug (This was when I took \~24 ng per PCR well)

Run two more PCR trials with double the amount of input:

| Reagent | Volume (µL) |
| ----- | ----- |
| **ligN40w107 PCR1** | **800** |
| **Phusion Master Mix** | **5000** |
| **NCAP\_F (10 µM)** | **500** |
| **NCAP\_R (10 uM)** | **500** |
| **Water** | **3200**  |
| **Total** | **10000** |

***3\. L11 ligation repeat***

6X of this L11 ligation repeat was purified by using 1.2X AmpureXP beads → 72 uL beads for 60 uL sample

Post purification measure concentration of this sample \=

Run \~ 10-15 ng of sample on a 0.5% agarose gel.

***3\. PCR & qPCR plate preparation for SELEX***

1 PCR (For 8 plates \= 4 NCAP-SELEX \+ 4 HT-SELEX \- For main PCR reactions

| PCR Plates |  |  |  |
| ----- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Reagents | per well in 384 | per 384-well plate | for 8 plates (x440) |
| NF water | 8.65μL | 3.323mL | 30.48mL |
| 5x Phusion HF buffer | 3.75μL | 1.440mL | 13.2mL |
| 10mM e dNTP | 0.75μL | 288μL | 2.64mL |
| NCAP\_F 100μM  | 0.075μL | 28.8μL | 264μL |
| NCAP\_R 100μM  | 0.075μL | 28.8μL | 264μL |
| MgCl2 (50mM) | 0.0975μL | 37.44μL | 343μL |
| Hot Start Phusion DNA Pol | 0.10875μL | 41.76μL | 383μL |
| Total | 13.51μL | 5.189mL | 47.57mL |

Repeat two times since there will be **16 plates** for lig147, ligN40w100. (i.e. prepare two 50mL falcons)  
Manually load 489μL mix into each well of a 96-well plate (AB0765), then transfer 13.5μL/well into 384-well plates (4ti-0384C).  
Seal the plates, freeze at \-20℃ until use.

To prepare 100x SYBR Green: add 5μL 10,000x SYBR Green into 500μL DMSO, which can be found in Phusion DNA Pol kits. Avoid light.  
Manually load 122μL mix into each well of a 96-well plate (AB0765), then transfer 4.5μL/well into 6x 384-well plates (LightCycler 384). Repeat twice because of two ligands \- lig147, ligN40w107.  
Seal the plates to avoid light. Freeze at \-20℃ until use.
